args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Incident opened to track and investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified — the service is now healthy (error rate 0.2%) across all regions.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer. The incident documents the rollback to v2.3.0 and notes that the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression still needs investigation.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback went to a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
